name: infomercial
brief: A bright, upbeat product spot for the Brewline, a compact countertop cold brew maker: a slim brushed-steel cylinder with a glass carafe and a single walnut dial. Shot in a sunlit Scandinavian kitchen with pale wood and white tiles; one presenter, Leo, a cheerful barista in his late twenties with curly hair and a striped apron. Clean, commercial, lots of close-ups of the product.
talk_track: Meet the Brewline, the cold brew maker that fits where your kettle used to be. Here is why people love it. One, it brews in four hours instead of overnight, so you decide in the afternoon and pour at dinner. Two, the walnut dial has three settings, smooth, bold and espresso strength, and it remembers the one you chose. Three, the carafe holds a full litre and goes straight into the fridge door. Four, every part lifts out and rinses clean in under a minute, with no filters to buy ever again. Five, it is quiet enough to run while the baby sleeps. The Brewline comes in steel, charcoal and cream, with a two year guarantee and free delivery. Order this week and we add the travel cup for nothing. Visit brewline dot com, pick your colour and your first cold brew is four hours away.
